reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 10 points better, in a game of about 217 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Warriors.
The mental side leans about 2 points towards the Celtics.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 77 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 191 and 240 total points.
